summary: PASS for the exact isolated host/renderer/shader source and retained native fixture evidence reviewed; no specific blocking defect found. This does not approve or complete the parent candidate.

findings.detail: Legacy default remains Assets/Supplied/AssetManifest.json with fullBaseSetBudget=false. The two trusted serialized fields flow only into Load(root,catalog,manifest,test,fullBaseSetBudget). No manifest/environment/process budget escalation was added. Actual native default/full fixture admits two/four unique large faces respectively. Unsafe/missing configured paths preserve generic art/foley and gameplay.

Smoke override is the exact existing artifact media-manifest.json only for existing smoke Paths. MediaFiles.Resolve performs lexical and root-to-leaf reparse validation before the File.Exists delegate. Failure falls back to configured safe manifest; an arbitrary configured .artifacts path does not enable test mode. Root/network checks and BaseSaveDirectory -> WithProfile(CollectionProfileId) -> selected save/artifact comparisons remain present. Handle validation/revalidation precedes reading bytes. Initial null/foreign/error/session prerequisites and Retry observation remain, without executing Retry.

Host neither requests playback nor creates an AudioSource, generates, saves, consumes RNG, acknowledges actions or mutates session state. Shutdown detaches bound library before disposing resources, stays terminal/idempotent and preserves external providers. Renderer owns and destroys its wrapper material in OnDestroy; it never destroys provider textures. Native deferred-destruction, external-texture-survival, silent bind and exact isolated restore/save-byte comparisons pass.

The chosen front-or-back face selects only that same role mask. Missing/dimension-mismatched masks skip the effect rather than borrowing the other mask or inferring full-face coverage. Both passes use the same ScaleToFit-derived fitted rectangle. Loader creates masks with linear=true and bilinear/clamped sampling after corresponding face validation. Shader uses mask.r*mask.a and a low-opacity neutral silver response driven by existing motion.Clock, not shader _Time/RNG. Resources path is retained in a release D3D11 fixture; owned material destruction is exercised.

Supplied faces/back use full neutral ScaleToFit and return before generic labels/badges. Existing explicit holo finish plus aligned same-dimension illustration mask remains required; Phase3Foil bytes match every checked historical RED pin. Default generic labels/art, no-mask fallback, accepted hover outline outside print and outside-art physical/NEW/duplicate information are retained. No edition warning or new printing identity is added.

Accepted hitboxes and request authority remain separate from animation. Ordinary reveal 11 keeps the explicit results gate; Skip, inspection Back/Escape, Binder gate and pause/focus/error clock freezes remain. Existing volume, lazy source and acknowledged-only once-consumed cues are unchanged in the reviewed bodies and supported by all retained legacy suites. Whole-candidate Binder/generation flows are not inferred from fixture screenshots.

Retained oracle permits only explicit one-source-texel transition support, not arbitrary outside-mask differences. Reviewer independently decoded every retained final PNG and evaluated whole-frame actual front/back/holo deltas against original mask red/alpha bilinear support without that padding: zero changes outside mask support or fitted rectangle. Synthetic wrapper boundary rows require the documented bounded transition allowance; none change solid black beyond it or letterboxing. Actual wrapper maximum channel delta is 30/255 and later movement 25/255. Inspection is visibly nonblank and byte-identical to its full production neutral-reference capture.

test_gaps.detail: The renderer fixture does not contain a dedicated positive-red/zero-alpha wrapper mask control. Shader red-times-alpha and linear mask construction are explicit in source; current actual/synthetic imagery is not a replacement for that adversarial GPU test.

The 87-check legacy-host all slice does not invoke its separate ReviewFixPaths symlink/existence-delegate slice. Resolve-before-exists and the resolver/handle checks were reviewed in full; do not describe the 576 total as a fresh native symlink-race or review-fix-slice execution.

Author Compare() scans an inset target region and uses a conservative one-source-texel transition classification. Reviewer whole-frame offline checks cover the entire retained effect images including wrapper fitted edges; synthetic normalized-texel-center modeling differences are confined to a boundary row and vanish within the declared transition footprint. This is not a claim that all possible GPU sampler/backend behavior was verified.

Native source staging copies shader bytes and proves Resources retention but generates isolated metadata. Source WrapperMetallic.shader.meta is pinned by this review, not proof that the parent scene/build has exact resource/GUID closure. Trusted full-budget/new-manifest setup on the actual new candidate and a real generated full-pack/Binder/retry/restore playthrough remain parent gates.

limitations: No native suites were rerun because execution of the shared renderer project was explicitly prohibited. Review independently checked retained native exits/reports/logs/current hashes and performed offline PNG/pixel calculations only.
576 is the sum of retained named assertion entries, including repeated layout assertions; it is not 576 independent end-to-end scenarios.

Actual private material loader bindings and representative GPU fixtures are real supplied-texture evidence, but the results screenshot manually projects eleven representative copies and is not a generated pack or probability test. The host restore fixture explicitly generates one isolated pack but is not a full candidate GUI/Binder playtest.

No human hearing, speaker quality, human acceptance, universal resolutions, additional graphics APIs/platforms, sustained performance, accepted-build safety by traversal, or phase completion is claimed.

Historical RED/GREEN provenance is retained report/exit/source-hash evidence; historical staged source bodies and per-run fixture binaries are not immutable archived source/build copies in the reviewed index. The corrected staged defect is independently reconstructable from current source and its exact recorded mutation.

Current 121 declarations and actual supplied files were verified against retained pins; original raw-art provenance/pixel authoring review and the separate authoring-report-count correction are outside this renderer review.
